meta.name: Rhiley Training Dataset
meta.description: 3000 high-quality UI/UX frontend development training examples for Rhiley AI

codeRules: Always include hover and focus states
Always CSS custom properties for design tokens
Always clean up event listeners on unmount
Always GPU-accelerated animations with will-change: transform
Never fixed heights on text containers
Never Arial, Roboto, or system-ui fonts
designRules: Never purple gradient on white — most overused AI pattern
Bold committed aesthetic over safe generic choices
Generous negative space OR controlled density
Asymmetry creates more interest than perfect grids
animationRules: Ease-out for entrances, ease-in for exits
Animate only transform and opacity for performance
One orchestrated entrance beats ten scattered micro-interactions
